**Repaired finding submitted — deviation (medium), Section 19.2.**

What changed in the repair:
- The redline now reads **"twelve (12) months"** instead of "twelve months", so the warranty period is expressed with an explicit numeral. This clears the deterministic check ("number not found"), which was triggered because both the original ("ninety days") and my first redline spelled the period only in words. Numeral-plus-words is also the conventional style for periods in this document family.
- The comment and rationale now state the fallback as **"ninety (90) days"** in the same numeral form, and the rationale expressly records that twelve months exceeds the 90-day floor and that ninety days is the playbook fallback.

Unchanged, per the verifier's confirmation that the classification and scope were correct:
- Only the duration in p0072 is edited; the Hosted Services full-term conformance, the authority warranty, the §19.4 re-perform/repair/replace-then-refund remedy (expressly non-exclusive) and the §19.5 disclaimer carve-out for express warranties all stand as drafted.
- Rationale continues to document that professional/workmanlike performance, documentation conformance, no malicious code, legal compliance, a real remedy and a non-swallowing disclaimer are already present, so duration was the sole gap.

Redline validated (ok:true) and the finding is filed.
